paragraphs.en: Aunt Em stepped outside to water the cabbages when she saw Dorothy running towards her.
paragraphs.zh: 艾姆姨妈正要出去给菜园里的甘蓝浇水，忽然看到多萝西飞奔而来。

paragraphs.en: "Darling child!" Aunt Em exclaimed, hugging Dorothy and kissing her face. "Where did you come from?"
paragraphs.zh: “亲爱的宝贝！”艾姆姨妈惊喜地喊道，紧紧抱住多萝西，并在她脸上亲了又亲。“你从哪里来的？”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy replied gravely, "From the Land of Oz. And here is Toto." She added with joy, "Aunt Em, I'm so glad to be home again."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西庄重地回答：“来自奥兹国。而这是托托。”她高兴地说，“艾姆姨妈，我终于回家了，真是太好了。”
